symptoms_en: Angular water-soaked lesions on leaves that turn brown-black. Boll rot and stem blackening in severe cases.
symptoms_gu: પાન પર કોણીય પાણી-ભરાયેલા ઘા જે ભૂરા-કાળા થાય છે. ગંભીર કિસ્સાઓમાં જીંડવા સડે છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर कोणीय जलसिक्त घाव जो भूरे-काले हो जाते हैं। गंभीर मामलों में बॉल सड़न।
causes: Bacterial infection spread through rain splash, contaminated seeds, and infected plant debris.
organic_treatment: Apply copper hydroxide spray. Remove and burn infected plant debris. Use neem oil spray at 3 ml/L.
chemical_treatment: Spray Streptomycin sulphate 500 ppm + Copper oxychloride 0.3%. Apply Copper hydroxide 77WP at 2.5 g/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply balanced NPK (120:60:60 kg/ha). Avoid excess nitrogen. Add potassium to strengthen cell walls.
prevention: Use resistant varieties (Bt cotton hybrids with blight tolerance). Treat seeds with Streptomycin 1g/L for 2 hours. Maintain proper plant spacing. Crop rotation with non-host crops.

symptoms_en: Upward or downward curling of leaves. Vein thickening and dark green coloration. Enations (outgrowths) on leaf underside. Stunted plant growth.
symptoms_gu: પાન ઉપર કે નીચે વળી જાય છે. નસો જાડી અને ઘાટા લીલા રંગની થાય છે. છોડની વૃદ્ધિ અટકે છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों का ऊपर या नीचे मुड़ना। नसों का मोटा होना। पौधे की वृद्धि रुकना।
causes: Transmitted by whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Virus spreads through vector feeding.
organic_treatment: Install yellow sticky traps for whitefly monitoring. Apply neem seed kernel extract 5%. Release Encarsia formosa parasitoids.
chemical_treatment: Spray Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.3 ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25 WG at 0.3 g/L for whitefly control. Diafenthiuron 50 WP at 1.2 g/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply recommended NPK. Supplement with micronutrients (Zinc sulphate 25 kg/ha, Boron 5 kg/ha).
prevention: Use tolerant Bt cotton hybrids. Early sowing to avoid peak whitefly population. Remove and destroy infected plants. Avoid ratoon cotton.

symptoms_en: Yellowing of lower leaves followed by wilting. Vascular browning visible when stem is cut. One-sided wilting is characteristic.
symptoms_gu: નીચેના પાન પીળા થાય અને પછી સુકાય છે. થડ ચીરતાં અંદર ભૂરી લીટીઓ દેખાય છે.
symptoms_hi: निचली पत्तियों का पीला पड़ना और मुरझाना। तने में भूरी धारियां दिखाई देती हैं।
causes: Soil-borne fungal pathogen. Persists in soil for many years. Spread through contaminated soil, water, and equipment.
organic_treatment: Apply Trichoderma viride at 2.5 kg/ha mixed with FYM. Use castor oil cake at 1 t/ha. Bio-fumigation with mustard residue.
chemical_treatment: Seed treatment with Carbendazim 2 g/kg. Soil drenching with Carbendazim 1 g/L at disease onset.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply FYM 10 t/ha. Balanced NPK with additional potash. Avoid excess nitrogen.
prevention: Use resistant varieties. Crop rotation with cereals (3-4 year cycle). Avoid waterlogging. Solarize soil during summer.

symptoms_en: Leaves turn reddish-purple, starting from margins. Premature boll opening. Reduced fiber quality.
symptoms_gu: પાન કિનારીથી લાલ-જાંબલી થાય છે. જીંડવા અપરિપક્વ ફાટે છે. રેસાની ગુણવત્તા ઘટે છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियां किनारों से लाल-बैंगनी होती हैं। अपरिपक्व बॉल फटना। रेशे की गुणवत्ता में कमी।
causes: Nutrient deficiency (Mg, N, P), high temperature fluctuation between day and night, sucking pest damage, or incompatible chemical sprays.
organic_treatment: Spray Magnesium sulphate 0.5-1.0% + DAP 2% solution. Apply neem oil for sucking pest control.
chemical_treatment: Foliar spray of Potassium nitrate 3% at boll formation stage, 3 sprays at 10-15 day intervals.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply Magnesium sulphate 25 kg/ha. Ensure adequate N, P, K, and micronutrients.
prevention: Balanced fertilization. Timely pest management. Avoid mixing incompatible chemicals.

symptoms_en: Dark brown circular spots with yellow halo on upper leaf surface. Spots may coalesce causing defoliation.
symptoms_gu: પાનની ઉપરની સપાટી પર ઘેરા ભૂરા ગોળાકાર ટપકાં, પીળા કિનારા સાથે. પાન ખરી પડે છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की ऊपरी सतह पर गहरे भूरे गोल धब्बे, पीले किनारों के साथ। पत्तियां गिर जाती हैं।
causes: Fungal pathogen favored by warm humid conditions. Spread through wind-borne spores.
organic_treatment: Apply Trichoderma harzianum as foliar spray. Use neem oil 3 ml/L at 15-day intervals.
chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75 WP at 2 g/L. Hexaconazole 5 EC at 2 ml/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply gypsum 500 kg/ha at flowering. Balanced NPK (20:40:40 kg/ha).
prevention: Use resistant varieties (GG-20, GAUG-10). Early sowing. Remove crop debris. Crop rotation.

symptoms_en: Dark brown to black circular spots on lower leaf surface. Spots are smaller and darker than early leaf spot. Severe defoliation.
symptoms_gu: પાનની નીચેની સપાટી પર ઘેરા ભૂરા-કાળા ટપકાં. પ્રારંભિક ટીક્કા કરતાં નાના અને વધુ ઘેરા.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की निचली सतह पर गहरे भूरे-काले धब्बे। प्रारंभिक टिक्का से छोटे और गहरे रंग के।
causes: Fungal pathogen. Appears later in crop cycle. Favored by high humidity.
organic_treatment: Bio-control with Pseudomonas fluorescens. Neem cake application at 250 kg/ha.
chemical_treatment: Spray Carbendazim 50 WP at 1 g/L or Propiconazole 25 EC at 1 ml/L. Apply at 45 and 60 DAS.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply recommended dose of fertilizers. Supplement with zinc sulphate 25 kg/ha.
prevention: Use tolerant varieties. Timely sowing. Proper plant spacing for air circulation.

symptoms_en: Orange-brown pustules on lower leaf surface. Pustules rupture releasing rust-colored spores. Premature leaf fall.
symptoms_gu: પાનની નીચેની સપાટી પર નારંગી-ભૂરા ફોલ્લા. ફોલ્લા ફાટી ગેરૂ રંગના બીજાણુ છૂટે છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की निचली सतह पर नारंगी-भूरे दाने। दाने फटकर जंग रंग के बीजाणु निकालते हैं।
causes: Fungal pathogen spread by wind-borne spores. Favored by temperatures 20-28°C with high humidity.
organic_treatment: Spray cow urine extract 10%. Apply Trichoderma viride.
chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2 g/L or Hexaconazole 5 EC at 2 ml/L at first appearance and 15 days later.
fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced NPK. Potash application strengthens plant defense.
prevention: Early maturing varieties. Destroy volunteer groundnut plants. Avoid late sowing.

symptoms_en: Orange-brown pustules scattered on upper leaf surface. Pustules are oval to round. Mild to moderate yield loss.
symptoms_gu: પાનની ઉપરની સપાટી પર છૂટાછવાયા નારંગી-ભૂરા ફોલ્લા. ફોલ્લા અંડાકાર-ગોળ હોય છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की ऊपरी सतह पर बिखरे हुए नारंगी-भूरे दाने। दाने अंडाकार-गोल होते हैं।
causes: Wind-borne fungal spores. Favored by cool temperatures and high humidity.
organic_treatment: Apply neem oil spray. Use resistant varieties as primary control.
chemical_treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25 EC at 1 ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9 EC at 1 ml/L at first appearance.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply 120:60:40 kg NPK/ha. Split nitrogen application.
prevention: Use resistant varieties (GW-496, GW-451). Timely sowing (November). Avoid excess nitrogen.

symptoms_en: White powdery growth on upper leaf surface. In severe cases covers entire plant. Reduces photosynthesis.
symptoms_gu: પાનની ઉપરની સપાટી પર સફેદ ભૂકી જેવી વૃદ્ધિ. ગંભીર કિસ્સામાં આખો છોડ ઢંકાઈ જાય છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों की ऊपरी सतह पर सफेद चूर्णी वृद्धि। गंभीर मामलों में पूरा पौधा ढक जाता है।
causes: Fungal spores spread by wind. Favored by cool dry weather with moderate humidity.
organic_treatment: Spray milk solution (1:9 ratio). Apply sulphur dust 25 kg/ha. Neem oil 3 ml/L.
chemical_treatment: Spray Carbendazim 50 WP at 1 g/L or Hexaconazole 5 EC at 2 ml/L or wettable sulphur 3 g/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced NPK (120:60:40). Avoid excess nitrogen which promotes succulent growth.
prevention: Use resistant varieties. Proper spacing. Avoid late sowing.

symptoms_en: Dark brown concentric ring-patterned spots on lower leaves first. Target-board appearance. Defoliation progresses upward.
symptoms_gu: નીચેના પાન પર ઘેરા ભૂરા સમકેન્દ્રી ગોળ ટપકાં. લક્ષ્ય-બોર્ડ જેવો દેખાવ. પાન ખરે છે.
symptoms_hi: निचली पत्तियों पर गहरे भूरे समकेंद्रित गोल धब्बे। लक्ष्य-बोर्ड जैसा दिखाई देता है।
causes: Soil-borne fungus. Survives in plant debris. Spread by wind and rain splash. Favored by warm, wet conditions.
organic_treatment: Apply Trichoderma viride. Spray Bordeaux mixture 1%. Neem oil spray.
chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil at 2 g/L. Azoxystrobin 23 SC at 1 ml/L for severe cases.
fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced NPK (120:60:60 kg/ha). Apply calcium to prevent blossom end rot.
prevention: Use disease-free seedlings. Mulching. Proper drainage. Crop rotation. Stake plants for air circulation.

symptoms_en: Large water-soaked patches on leaves turning brown-black. White cottony growth on leaf underside. Rapid plant collapse.
symptoms_gu: પાન પર મોટા પાણી ભરાયેલા ઘા જે ભૂરા-કાળા થાય છે. પાનની નીચે સફેદ ફૂગ.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर बड़े जलसिक्त धब्बे जो भूरे-काले होते हैं। पत्तियों के नीचे सफेद रुई जैसी वृद्धि।
causes: Oomycete pathogen. Spreads rapidly in cool wet weather. Can destroy entire crop in days.
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture 1% spray. Copper-based organic fungicides.
chemical_treatment: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) 2.5 g/L. Cymoxanil + Mancozeb 3 g/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced NPK. Ensure adequate potassium and calcium.
prevention: Use resistant varieties. Avoid overhead irrigation. Ensure proper spacing and drainage. Destroy crop residues.

symptoms_en: Upward curling and yellowing of leaf margins. Stunted growth. Flower drop. Severely reduced fruit set.
symptoms_gu: પાનના કિનારા ઉપર વળે છે અને પીળા થાય છે. વૃદ્ધિ અટકે છે. ફૂલ ખરે છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्ती के किनारे ऊपर की ओर मुड़ जाते हैं और पीले हो जाते हैं। वृद्धि रुक जाती है। फूल गिर जाते हैं।
causes: Transmitted by whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Persistent, circulative transmission.
organic_treatment: Yellow sticky traps. Neem oil sprays. Release Encarsia formosa. Reflective mulch.
chemical_treatment: Control whitefly vectors: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.3 ml/L or Pyriproxyfen 10 EC at 2 ml/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: Standard NPK. Supplement with micronutrients to support plant vigor.
prevention: Use TYLCV-resistant varieties. Insect-proof nursery. Crop-free period. Remove infected plants immediately.

symptoms_en: Water-soaked lesions on leaf tips and margins. White sporulation on underside. Tuber rot with reddish-brown discoloration.
symptoms_gu: પાનના ટોચ અને કિનારે પાણી ભરાયેલા ઘા. નીચે સફેદ ફૂગ. કંદ સડે છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों के शीर्ष और किनारों पर जलसिक्त घाव। नीचे सफेद बीजाणु। कंद सड़न।
causes: Oomycete pathogen. Cool and humid conditions favor epidemics. Spread through infected tubers and wind.
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture 1%. Copper hydroxide sprays.
chemical_treatment: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb 2.5 g/L. Cymoxanil + Mancozeb 3 g/L. Preventive: Mancozeb alone.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 150:60:100 kg/ha for potato. Adequate potash strengthens tuber skin.
prevention: Use certified disease-free seed potatoes. Resistant varieties (Kufri Pukhraj, Kufri Jyoti). Ridge planting. Avoid over-irrigation.

symptoms_en: Concentric ring pattern (target-board) dark brown spots on lower leaves. Spreads upward. Premature defoliation.
symptoms_gu: નીચેના પાન પર લક્ષ્ય-બોર્ડ જેવા ઘેરા ભૂરા ટપકાં. ઉપર તરફ ફેલાય છે.
symptoms_hi: निचली पत्तियों पर लक्ष्य-बोर्ड जैसे गहरे भूरे धब्बे। ऊपर की ओर फैलता है।
causes: Soil-borne fungus. Warm humid weather. Poor plant nutrition increases susceptibility.
organic_treatment: Trichoderma viride. Bordeaux mixture 1%. Neem oil.
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g/L. Chlorothalonil 75 WP at 2 g/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced NPK. Maintain plant vigor to resist infection.
prevention: Crop rotation. Remove debris. Resistant varieties. Proper irrigation scheduling.

symptoms_en: Chlorosis of leaves in parallel streaks. Ear head replaced by leafy green structures (green ear). White cottony growth on underside.
symptoms_gu: પાન પર સમાંતર પટ્ટાઓમાં પીળાશ. ડૂંડા બદલે લીલા પાન જેવા ભાગ બને છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर समानांतर धारियों में पीलापन। बाली के स्थान पर हरे पत्ते जैसी संरचना बनती है।
causes: Soil-borne and seed-borne oospores. Cool and humid conditions favor disease.
organic_treatment: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride. Remove infected plants and destroy.
chemical_treatment: Seed treatment with Metalaxyl (Apron 35 SD) at 6 g/kg seed. Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb if needed.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 80:40:0 kg/ha as recommended for bajra. Apply N in split doses.
prevention: Use resistant hybrids (GHB-558, GHB-744). Seed treatment mandatory. Crop rotation. Remove green ear plants.

symptoms_en: Reddening and drying of third and fourth leaf from top. Splitting cane shows red discoloration with white patches. Foul smell.
symptoms_gu: ઉપરથી ત્રીજા-ચોથા પાન લાલ થઈ સુકાય છે. શેરડી ચીરતાં લાલ રંગ સફેદ ટપકાં સાથે.
symptoms_hi: ऊपर से तीसरे-चौथे पत्ते लाल होकर सूखते हैं। गन्ना चीरने पर लाल रंग सफेद धब्बों के साथ।
causes: Fungal pathogen entering through borer holes or cut ends. Seed-borne and soil-borne.
organic_treatment: Treat setts with Trichoderma viride in pressmud (8 t/ha). Remove and burn infected clumps.
chemical_treatment: Sett treatment: Soak in Carbendazim 1 g/L for 10 min before planting. Soil drenching with Carbendazim.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 250:100:120 kg/ha for sugarcane. Organic FYM 10 t/ha.
prevention: Use resistant varieties. Sett treatment is mandatory. Long crop rotation. Avoid ratoon in infected fields.

symptoms_en: Black whip-like structure emerges from the top of the cane. Covered with a shiny membrane containing black spores.
symptoms_gu: શેરડીની ટોચમાંથી કાળી ચાબુક જેવી રચના નીકળે છે. ચળકતી પડદામાં કાળા બીજાણુ.
symptoms_hi: गन्ने के शीर्ष से काली चाबुक जैसी संरचना निकलती है। चमकदार झिल्ली में काले बीजाणु।
causes: Fungal spores infect buds. Air-borne spread. Favored by dry hot weather.
organic_treatment: Remove and burn whip structures before membrane ruptures. Bio-control with Trichoderma.
chemical_treatment: Sett treatment with Carbendazim 1 g/L. Hot water treatment of setts (50°C for 2 hours).
fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced NPK. Avoid excess nitrogen which makes plants more susceptible.
prevention: Use smut-resistant varieties. Rogue out infected stools immediately. Avoid ratoon from infected fields.

symptoms_en: Dark irregular spots on leaves, flowers, and fruits. Blossom blight causing flower drop. Fruit shows sunken dark lesions during ripening.
symptoms_gu: પાન, ફૂલ અને ફળ પર ઘેરા અનિયમિત ટપકાં. ફૂલ ખરે છે. ફળ પાકતી વખતે ઊંડા ઘેરા ઘા.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों, फूलों और फलों पर गहरे अनियमित धब्बे। फूल गिर जाते हैं। फल पकने पर धँसे हुए गहरे घाव।
causes: Fungal infection favored by humid weather during flowering. Spread by rain splash.
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture 1% spray at flowering. Neem oil 3 ml/L.
chemical_treatment: Spray Carbendazim 50 WP 1 g/L or Thiophanate methyl 1 g/L at panicle emergence, full bloom, and fruit set.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 1:0.5:1 ratio. Apply FYM 50 kg/tree. Micronutrient spray (Zn, B, Fe).
prevention: Prune dead wood. Proper spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation during flowering.

symptoms_en: White powdery coating on flowers, young fruits, and leaves. Causes flower and fruit drop. Severely reduces yield.
symptoms_gu: ફૂલ, નાના ફળ અને પાન પર સફેદ ભૂકી જેવો પડ. ફૂલ અને ફળ ખરે છે.
symptoms_hi: फूलों, छोटे फलों और पत्तियों पर सफेद चूर्णी आवरण। फूल और फल गिर जाते हैं।
causes: Fungal pathogen. Cool nights with warm days and low humidity favor the disease.
organic_treatment: Dust wettable sulphur 3 g/L. Neem oil spray 5 ml/L.
chemical_treatment: Spray wettable sulphur 3 g/L or Hexaconazole 5 EC at 2 ml/L. Apply at panicle emergence.
fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced nutrition. Foliar spray of KNO3 1% improves fruit retention.
prevention: Prune overcrowded canopy. Timely spray schedule. Avoid excess nitrogen.

symptoms_en: Yellowing of lower leaves from margin. Leaves droop and form skirt around pseudostem. Splitting of pseudostem base. Vascular browning.
symptoms_gu: નીચેના પાન કિનારીથી પીળા થાય છે. પાન ઝૂકી પડે છે. થડ ફાટે છે. અંદર ભૂરો રંગ.
symptoms_hi: निचले पत्ते किनारे से पीले होते हैं। पत्ते झूक जाते हैं। तना फटता है। अंदर भूरा रंग।
causes: Soil-borne fungus. Persists in soil for decades. Spread through contaminated soil and water.
organic_treatment: Apply Trichoderma viride with neem cake. Bio-fumigation. Pseudomonas fluorescens application.
chemical_treatment: Soil drenching with Carbendazim 1 g/L. No effective chemical cure once established.
fertilizer_recommendation: Apply FYM 10 kg/plant. NPK 200:60:300 g/plant. Ensure adequate potash.
prevention: Use resistant varieties (Grand Naine TR4-resistant). Tissue culture plants. Strict quarantine. Avoid flood irrigation.

symptoms_en: Upward curling, puckering, and thickening of leaves. Stunted growth. Reduced fruit size and number.
symptoms_gu: પાન ઉપર વળે છે, કરચલી પડે છે અને જાડા થાય છે. વૃદ્ધિ અટકે છે. ફળ ઓછા અને નાના.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियां ऊपर की ओर मुड़ जाती हैं, सिकुड़ जाती हैं और मोटी हो जाती हैं। वृद्धि रुक जाती है।
causes: Transmitted by whitefly (Bemisia tabaci). Virus-vector relationship.
organic_treatment: Yellow sticky traps. Neem oil 5 ml/L. Release predatory insects.
chemical_treatment: Control whitefly: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.3 ml/L. Thiamethoxam 25 WG at 0.3 g/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 100:50:50 kg/ha. Supplement with micronutrients.
prevention: Use tolerant varieties. Raise seedlings under insect-proof net. Remove infected plants. Barrier crops.

symptoms_en: Purple-brown oval lesions on leaves with concentric rings. Yellowing and drying of leaf tips. Bulb size reduced.
symptoms_gu: પાન પર જાંબલી-ભૂરા અંડાકાર ઘા સમકેન્દ્રી ગોળ સાથે. પાનની ટોચ પીળી થઈ સુકાય છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर बैंगनी-भूरे अंडाकार घाव समकेंद्रित छल्लों के साथ। पत्तियों की नोक पीली होकर सूखती है।
causes: Fungal pathogen. Favored by warm humid weather. Spreads through wind-borne conidia.
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture 1%. Neem oil spray. Trichoderma application.
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75 WP at 2 g/L at 10-day intervals.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 100:50:50 kg/ha. Apply sulphur for pungency and disease resistance.
prevention: Use healthy seedlings. Proper spacing. Avoid overhead irrigation. Crop rotation.

symptoms_en: Grey mold on capsules during rainy weather. Capsules rot and shrivel. Seeds become discolored.
symptoms_gu: વરસાદી હવામાનમાં ટોપડા પર રાખોડી ફૂગ. ટોપડા સડે છે. બીજ કથ્થાઈ થાય છે.
symptoms_hi: बारिश के मौसम में कैप्सूल पर धूसर फफूंद। कैप्सूल सड़ जाते हैं। बीज रंगहीन हो जाते हैं।
causes: Fungal infection favored by continuous wet weather during capsule maturation.
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected capsules. Improve air circulation by wider spacing.
chemical_treatment: Spray Carbendazim 50 WP at 1 g/L or Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g/L.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 40:40:0 kg/ha. Do not over-fertilize with nitrogen.
prevention: Early maturing varieties. Timely harvest. Proper drainage. Avoid dense planting.

symptoms_en: Dark brown circular spots with concentric rings on leaves and pods. Premature pod shattering. Seed shriveling.
symptoms_gu: પાન અને ફળી પર ઘેરા ભૂરા ગોળ ટપકાં સમકેન્દ્રી ગોળ સાથે. ફળી અકાળે ફાટે છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों और फलियों पर गहरे भूरे गोल धब्बे समकेंद्रित छल्लों के साथ। फलियां समय पूर्व फट जाती हैं।
causes: Seed-borne and air-borne fungal pathogen. Favored by warm humid weather.
organic_treatment: Spray neem oil 5 ml/L. Trichoderma seed treatment.
chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g/L or Iprodione 50 WP at 2 g/L. Two sprays at flowering and pod formation.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 80:40:40 kg/ha. Sulphur 40 kg/ha for oilseed quality.
prevention: Use tolerant varieties. Seed treatment. Timely sowing. Destroy crop residues.

symptoms_en: Sudden wilting of plants. Lower leaves droop first. Vascular browning in stem cross-section. Occurs in patches in field.
symptoms_gu: છોડ અચાનક સુકાય છે. નીચેના પાન પહેલાં ઝૂકે છે. થડ ચીરતાં ભૂરા દેખાય છે.
symptoms_hi: पौधों का अचानक मुरझाना। निचले पत्ते पहले झुक जाते हैं। तने में भूरापन दिखाई देता है।
causes: Soil-borne fungal pathogen. Favored by warm, moist soil conditions.
organic_treatment: Trichoderma viride seed treatment 4 g/kg. Bio-fumigation. Neem cake 250 kg/ha.
chemical_treatment: Seed treatment Carbendazim 2 g/kg. Soil drenching with Carbendazim 1 g/L at disease onset.
fertilizer_recommendation: NPK 30:20:0 kg/ha. Apply FYM 5 t/ha.
prevention: Long crop rotation (4+ years). Resistant varieties (GC-4). Seed treatment mandatory. Avoid waterlogging.

symptoms_en: Dark brown necrotic spots on leaves and stems. Blighting of umbels. Seeds become shriveled and discolored.
symptoms_gu: પાન અને દાંડી પર ઘેરા ભૂરા મરેલા ટપકાં. છત્રકો ઝળસે છે. બીજ સંકોચાય છે.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों और तनों पर गहरे भूरे मृत धब्बे। छत्रकों का झुलसना। बीज सिकुड़ जाते हैं।
causes: Seed-borne and air-borne fungal pathogen. Favored by dew and foggy conditions.
organic_treatment: Neem oil spray 5 ml/L. Remove and burn infected plant debris.
chemical_treatment: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP at 2.5 g/L. Three sprays at 15-day intervals from first appearance.
fertilizer_recommendation: Balanced NPK 30:20:0 kg/ha.
prevention: Seed treatment. Timely sowing (November). Avoid excess irrigation. Proper spacing.

symptoms_en: Ring-shaped spots on fruits. Mosaic patterns on leaves. Shoe-string leaves in severe cases. Stunted growth.
symptoms_gu: ફળ પર વલયાકાર ટપકાં. પાન પર મોઝેક. ગંભીર કિસ્સામાં પાન દોરી જેવા. વૃદ્ધિ અટકે.
symptoms_hi: फलों पर वलय आकार के धब्बे। पत्तियों पर मोज़ेक। गंभीर मामलों में पत्तियां धागे जैसी। वृद्धि रुकना।
causes: Transmitted by aphids (Aphis gossypii, Myzus persicae). Non-persistent transmission.
organic_treatment: Mineral oil sprays to reduce aphid transmission. Remove infected plants immediately.
chemical_treatment: Control aphid vectors: Imidacloprid 17.8 SL at 0.3 ml/L. No cure for virus-infected plants.
fertilizer_recommendation: FYM 20 kg/pit. NPK 200:200:400 g/plant/year.
prevention: Use PRSV-tolerant varieties. Cross-protection with mild strains. Barrier crops. Remove cucurbit weeds (alternate hosts).
